task: Extend file attachments to codemie-gemini via a reusable UploadsDetector abstraction layer shared across CLI agents

key_reasoning.reason: Touches chat/index.ts (consumer refactor), claudeUploadsDetector.ts (interface impl + DetectedFile extraction), chat/types.ts (new UploadsDetector interface + DetectedFile), new geminiUploadsDetector.ts, and possibly a factory/selector module — 4+ components across CLI command and abstraction layers, with both Claude and Gemini agents affected; bumped from L to XL by 'affects multiple agents' red flag

Core objectives are stated (Gemini attachment support, shared abstraction, constraint documentation, no regression), but design decisions remain open: factory vs strategy pattern for UploadsDetector selection, whether gemini.conversations-processor.ts file_names hardcode is in scope, and how to handle the architectural fact that Gemini sessions contain no embedded file blobs (session-based detection will likely be a no-op)

Introduces a novel UploadsDetector interface and factory pattern with no direct codebase precedent; refactoring claudeUploadsDetector.ts risks breaking the comprehensive existing test suite; GeminiPlugin has zero unit tests today; no security or performance sensitivity
